lines.text: The Israelites set out from Mount Sinai along the route to the Red Sea, to bypass the land of Edom.
The people spoke against God and Moses, saying there was no bread or water in the wilderness.
The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and many Israelites were bitten and died.
The people confessed their sin to Moses and asked him to intercede so the LORD would take the snakes away.
The LORD told Moses to make a fiery serpent, so Moses made a golden snake and mounted it on a pole.
